entities.name: Smart TV
entities.rationale: Drawn as a TV screen on the far left sending telemetry (Logs, Perf, User data).

entities.name: Kinesis Data Streams
entities.rationale: AWS Kinesis icon labeled 'KINESIS' acting as the ingestion front door.

entities.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
entities.rationale: AWS Kinesis Data Firehose icon labeled 'KINESIS FIREHOSE' routing data to S3 and Redshift.

entities.name: S3 Bucket
entities.rationale: AWS S3 icon labeled 'S3' acting as long-term raw data storage.

entities.name: Amazon Redshift
entities.rationale: AWS Redshift icon labeled 'REDSHIFT' acting as data warehouse.

entities.name: Amazon QuickSight
entities.rationale: AWS QuickSight icon labeled 'QUICKSIGHT' used for reporting and visualization.

visual_connections.description: Sends logs, performance, and user telemetry directly to Kinesis.
Pipes stream data to Kinesis Data Firehose.
Dumps raw data into S3 for long-term storage.
Ingests data directly into Redshift data warehouse.
Loads data from Redshift to QuickSight/SPICE for visualization.
